name: chaos-room-simulator
description: Simulated control room devices publishing telemetry to AWS IoT Core over MQTT (mTLS)

scripts.start: IOT_ENDPOINT=$(aws iot describe-endpoint --endpoint-type iot:Data-ATS --query endpointAddress --output text) node index.mjs
scripts.scenario: IOT_ENDPOINT=$(aws iot describe-endpoint --endpoint-type iot:Data-ATS --query endpointAddress --output text) node scenario.mjs
